reason: I'd take the free first visit on a Saturday just to see if it's actually cleaner and calmer than CoCo's. If it is, I'd pay for a visit or two, but only on weekends since I work full time.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? The zoo is free, so $15 a kid on a Saturday has to feel clearly better, and I only have weekends so I'd never get my money's worth from the monthly plan.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the weekend cap really keeps it uncrowded and the place is visibly spotless on my free visit.
